mvp.description: MVP primary, language, KB, secondary, and bounded challenge raw sources.

full.description: Project full-profile inputs: MVP plus core/candidate/challenge extensions. This is not a mirror of every upstream bucket.

full-upstream.description: Literal upstream releases where meaningful. Multi-terabyte, partly gated, and not required by the 4,500-query project full profile.

rpc.reason: The official package is distributed through a click-through/Kaggle-style access path; no account credentials or mutable third-party mirror belong in the repository.
rpc.instructions: Accept the RPC terms, obtain the official package URLs or local files, then replace this source with artifacts in a local overrides JSON.

fashioniq.reason: Official annotations and image URL lists are public, but the image corpus is a large set of mutable third-party URLs rather than a revision-pinned archive.
fashioniq.instructions: Freeze the official fashion-iq annotations commit and dress/shirt/toptee URL inventory; after bounded retries, record unresolved URLs in an explicit owner-approved exclusion ledger, verify accepted-plus-excluded coverage, then expose the finalized acquisition through a local command override.

cord_v2.reason: CORD v2 is hosted as a multi-file Hugging Face repository whose immutable revision must be selected and frozen before formal use.
cord_v2.instructions: Freeze a naver-clova-ix/cord-v2 commit, export its parquet artifact URLs/sizes/hashes, and add them through a local overrides JSON.

sroie.reason: The official SROIE distribution uses gated or mutable file-hosting links.
sroie.instructions: Obtain the official packages under their terms, freeze a reviewed browser-acquisition manifest, validate ZIP structure and content identity, then provide the already acquired files through a local_artifacts override.

deepfashion.reason: DeepFashion access requires accepting the dataset release agreement.
deepfashion.instructions: Request access from the official project, retain the agreement evidence outside Git, and provide the authorized archives through a local overrides JSON.

simmc_2_1.reason: SIMMC 2.1 is a conditional Full candidate whose Git LFS objects, archived repository revision, CC BY-NC-SA terms and English synthetic-scene scope must be reviewed before use.
simmc_2_1.instructions: Freeze the official repository/LFS object inventory and license evidence, then decide whether its multimodal-coreference structures may be transformed into separately marked Chinese synthetic/derived trajectories.

csds.reason: The official CSDS train/val/test package is already acquired and the project owner has confirmed written permission covering use, derivation and redistribution.
csds.instructions: Retain the permission notice outside Git and reuse the verified local package; a later Full activation still requires its separate source/PII/selection review.

products_10k.reason: Products-10K is distributed through account/file-hosting flows without a stable anonymous archive URL.
products_10k.instructions: Acquire the official release, freeze its package identity, and provide artifacts through a local overrides JSON.

polyvore.reason: The canonical Polyvore metadata and image availability are split across mutable hosting; many original image URLs are no longer live.
polyvore.instructions: Choose and document an authorized image-bearing snapshot plus the official metadata revision, then provide its frozen artifacts through a local overrides JSON.

recipe1m_plus_selected.reason: Recipe1M+ requires an approved download and the project full plan needs a reviewed entity-mapped selection rather than an indiscriminate mirror.
recipe1m_plus_selected.instructions: After access approval, create a frozen selected-artifact inventory for mapped recipe/image pairs and inject it with a local overrides JSON.

mep3m_upstream_all.reason: The literal release contains 599 archives (71,869,244,985 bytes) and must use a frozen Hugging Face tree inventory rather than a mutable generated list.
mep3m_upstream_all.instructions: Export the 599 Images/*.rar objects from revision 4f38a7404a7c78d849169a480f77af593fb78d03 with sizes and LFS SHA-256 values into a local overrides JSON.

open_images_all.reason: Open Images is a versioned multi-object bucket; a complete run needs a frozen object inventory and split/version decision.
open_images_all.instructions: Freeze the chosen Open Images version, annotations, and exact S3 object list, then add all objects as artifacts through a local overrides JSON.

recipe1m_plus_all.reason: The full authorized Recipe1M+ image release is roughly 16 large archives and several terabytes.
recipe1m_plus_all.instructions: After approval, place the authorized archive URLs in a local overrides JSON. Do not commit signed URLs or cookies.

retired_sources.reason: Owner decision: access is not currently obtainable and JDDC 2.0 is no longer a required MVP or Full RAW dependency.
Owner decision: U-NEED access is not obtainable even after application, so it is no longer a project dependency.
